home.heroSubtitle: Portrait, event, automotive and architecture photography — crafted with intention and precision.
home.introTitle:
Visual stories told
with *precision* and
natural light
introText: I'm a photographer based in Slovakia with a passion for clean, cinematic imagery. Whether it's capturing the character of a portrait, the energy of an event, the lines of a car, or the geometry of architecture — every frame is intentional.
My approach is calm and collaborative. I aim for images that feel timeless rather than trendy.
home.ctaText: Available for bookings across Slovakia and nearby regions. Get in touch to discuss your project.

about.label: About
about.title:
Creating memories
that last
*forever*
paragraphs: I have a passion for capturing the beauty and emotion of life's precious moments. I specialize in portraits, automotive, architecture, and events, and have a keen eye for detail and composition.
With years of experience and a deep understanding of light and technical aspects of photography, I am able to create stunning, timeless images that my clients will treasure for a lifetime.

I take the time to get to know my clients, understand their needs and preferences, and work with them to create a personalized photography experience. Trust me to document your special moments and create memories that will last forever.
